{{Quote|I wasn't the one who sent your brother to prison. He sent himself. He shouldn't have been selling contraband.|Psyrel Capanus, to Phelar University security guards|<ref name="Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>}}
'''Psyrel Capanus''' was a tall, scrawny [[Gender/Legends|male]] scholar working at [[Phelar University]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. He had wealth and ambition, and overlooked the faults of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], which was typical for most citizens of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He was keen to provide references to [[Phelar University Archive]] to any visiting scholars who requested for them.

In around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Capanus was assaulted by two security guards of the campus. The exact reasons were unclear, but it involved contraband dealt by the brother of one of the guards. Other scholars noticed the fight, but they feared getting involved.
